verdict.rationale: AWS IAM lets you attach JSON permission policies to roles and users, including permissions boundaries. Assuming a role issues temporary, session-scoped credentials with no long-term access keys, and OIDC federation extends this to external workloads. Together these let a user issue narrowly scoped credentials for an agent, and AgentCore adds agent-specific authentication and access control. Missing for 10: an explicit agent-oriented least-privilege credential-issuance walkthrough (AgentCore claims are marketing-level), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
